title: Pumptech
description: About Pumptech PumpTech, headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is a premier distributor of high-quality pumping products and systems in the Pacific Northwest. As a result of the attack on The Pumptech, more than 150 GB of confidential data was stolen. This data includes more than 158,000 files containing property and maintenance documentation, documents related to owners and tenants - including personal data-financial reports, banking information, and other important company information.
